name: Generic Android TV / Google TV
description: Google components found on most Android TV and Google TV sets. Safe for any brand.
sources_note: despy = github.com/aviv0404/tcl-tv-despy; other names refer to public community write-ups of the same packages.
never_break: Enforced in code (harden.py) and listed in docs/NEVER-BREAK.md; a profile cannot override it.

items.title: Switch off com.android.tv.feedbackconsent
items.why: Feedback consent dialog for Google bug reports

items.title: Switch off android.autoinstalls.config.google.gtvpai
items.why: Play Auto Installs: pushes partner apps onto the TV
